description: workers/scripts/{script_name}/edge-preview is absent from the API docs (docs-absent endpoint): multipart preview-worker upload authorized by the cf-preview-upload-config-token header (from createSubdomainEdgePreviewSession), answering a preview_token to send as cf-workers-preview-token against the preview host. Shapes transcribed from the distilled SDK; metadata is the edge-preview's OWN type (v0 parity: preview-only `raw` binding flags, logfwdr/stream/unsafe_hello_world kinds, d1 by `id`, capnp_schema, streaming tail consumers). Needed by alchemy's EdgeSession (state-store login / preview uploads).
